name: ht-business-patente
description: Haiti business patente reference under the replacement Tax Code effective 1 October 2026. Covers establishment-level liability, the fixed and proportional components, current commune groupings, turnover and payroll definitions, rounding, new-business treatment and filing evidence. Includes a worked calculation and distinguishes special rules for professionals, artisans and nonprofit entities. Uses the enactment rather than conflicting old webpage formulas and municipality lists. Incorporation, other business permissions, negative-base treatment, operational implementation decisions and independent accountant review are not established by this source-cited draft.
